title: Pura Vida | KEY.co
description_expanded: Nestled within the serene Treetop Community of Seacrest Beach, Pura Vida is a coastal retreat that perfectly blends tranquility and convenience. This three-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bathroom home offers an inviting escape for families seeking a memorable getaway along Florida's famed 30A. Surrounded by lush nature yet just moments from the shore, this charming property provides a peaceful haven with easy access to Seacrest Beach’s private entrance and the community’s sparkling pool. Every detail of Pura Vida is crafted to deliver comfort and relaxation, making it the ideal destination for any season. Situated between the iconic Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach, Seacrest Beach embodies the laid-back elegance of the Emerald Coast. With 30A’s 20 miles of pristine white-sand beaches and vibrant coastal towns at your doorstep, Pura Vida serves as the perfect base to explore the area’s boutique shops, delectable seafood, and one-of-a-kind charm. Whether you’re savoring sunsets on the sand or discovering the distinct personalities of 30A’s unique communities, this home invites you to experience the essence of coastal living at its finest.
